payload.title: An AI reply reaches the user only whole, after every model turn has finished: the providers call the non-streaming API, request.ai.chat answers once, and the messaging channel and the assistant socket can show nothing until then
evidence: apps/ai-service/src/agent/providers/openai.provider.ts:99 (chat.completions.create: the whole completion; Z.ai inherits it)
apps/messaging-service/src/ai/services/ai-chat-bridge.service.ts:733 (the AI channel bridge awaits that one reply, up to 60 s)
apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/ai-chat.gateway.ts:243 (the assistant socket awaits it too, then emits ai:response)
payload.rule_violated: A reply the model writes over seconds is shown to the user as it is written, through the same safety stage as the stored reply
payload.notes: Raised from the operator's request (2026-10-30) that AI answers appear as they are typed, as in Claude, instead of all at once.
